source_blobs.agent_materialize_agent_wiring_py: current fresh source read on PR8; pair transaction owns account_pool.py + server.py only

observed_contract: Agent crash-safe materializer journals and commits only account_pool.py + server.py.
Core V45 additionally changes payload/reservation_aware_lease.py so DynamicReservationLeaseSession can forward allow_failover=False.

V47 composes all three files, but its --apply path is explicitly disposable and writes account_pool.py, server.py, reservation_aware_lease.py directly rather than under one product publication protocol.
Therefore a real composed publication protocol is still missing for the third file.

reproduced_failure_window.effect: a protected Stage-B caller that passes allow_failover=False reaches the old wrapper contract and is incompatible; the existing pair journal can regard account_pool+server as fully new while knowing nothing about the wrapper

safe_staging_candidate: First publish/read-back/compile the V45 reservation_aware_lease.py compatibility shim. Its default allow_failover=True path preserves old Agent behavior and does not require V41 AccountLease support.
Only after wrapper verification, atomically publish account_pool.py + server.py through the existing Agent pair journal/recovery protocol.
A crash after wrapper-first but before the pair commit is backward-compatible; a successful pair commit cannot expose protected Stage-B without wrapper support.
Recovery/evidence must distinguish wrapper-prepared from pair-committed and must never claim final composed PASS from only the two-file journal.
required_regression: wrapper-old + server/account-new must never be a publishable/final state
wrapper-new + server/account-old keeps default Agent behavior
crash/restart at each publication boundary converges without weakening exact preimage guards
limits: No Notion/Qwen product file was changed.
No Windows, production, user data, account state or secrets.
